description: Source code for Intel DAI Digital Microphone (DMIC) driver in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, control, and interrupt handling for DMIC hardware.

methods.name: exp_small_fixed
methods.description: Calculates exponential for small x using Taylor series approximation.

methods.name: db2lin_fixed
methods.description: Converts decibel value to linear scale in fixed-point.

methods.name: dai_dmic_update_bits
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a DMIC register.

methods.name: dai_dmic_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a DMIC register.

methods.name: dai_dmic_read
methods.description: Reads a value from a DMIC register.

methods.name: dai_dmic_claim_ownership
methods.description: Claims ownership of DMIC hardware (if supported).

methods.name: dai_dmic_release_ownership
methods.description: Releases ownership of DMIC hardware (if supported).

methods.name: dai_dmic_base
methods.description: Returns base address for DMIC registers depending on platform.

methods.name: dai_dmic_set_sync_period
methods.description: Sets synchronization period for DMIC line.

methods.name: dai_dmic_irq_handler
methods.description: Handles DMIC interrupt events, logs status, and manages overrun conditions.

methods.name: dai_dmic_remove
methods.description: Removes DMIC hardware, disables clocks and power if no active FIFOs.

methods.name: dai_dmic_gain_ramp
methods.description: Gradually ramps volume gain over time.

methods.name: dai_dmic_probe_wrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for probing DMIC device, manages reference count.

methods.name: dai_dmic_remove_wrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for removing DMIC device, manages reference count.

methods.name: dai_dmic_initialize_device
methods.description: Initializes DMIC device, connects IRQ, and enables runtime power management.

methods.name: DAI_INTEL_DMIC_DEVICE_INIT
methods.description: Macro to instantiate and initialize DMIC device instances based on device tree.
